_readme: Trigger-eval set for .agents/skills routing. Schema per entry: id, query (exact prompt sent), set (train|validation), should (skills expected to load; [] means no skill should be needed), note (label rationale, incl. where labels were corrected after measurement rather than to fit it). dotnet must be absent from every neg-* run. Method and measured results: see trigger-results.md.
